Name: Alex is Black
Author: snuffpot
Description:
Update: I've changed this mod to a content patcher version, so it now requires Content Patcher.

Made a black Alex replacement mod.

His portrait is based more off [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13]Kamirose's Overhauls[/url]﻿ than off the original portrait, but I also modelled him heavily off of Donald Glover, even if he isn't recognizable as him or anything.

Unzip this zip, and follow the instructions in the read me or here:

To install:
[list]
[*]Copy [CP] AlexIsBlack folder into to your Stardew Valley --> Mods folder
[/list]
This mod 'edits' the sprite and portrait sheets for Alex (both Alex and Alex_Beach). It's not compatible with other mods that alter these files in its current state.

Downloads.Description: Version 2.0 Content Patcher version of mod.
